editorial.blurb: Baha brings authentic, exceptionally fresh seafood to Chicago with warm hospitality and consistently outstanding service that makes every visit feel special.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the 7 Mares soup — a reviewer who's eaten mariscos across the country from Tijuana to Boston calls it the best they've had anywhere.

topDishes.note: Legendary — reviewers rave it's the best in the country
